to: jeffweisbein/openclaw-starter-kit maintainers or commercial team via the repository's public contact route
subject: Bounded ai-agents integration pilot for jeffweisbein/openclaw-starter-kit
body:
Hello jeffweisbein/openclaw-starter-kit maintainers,

I found jeffweisbein/openclaw-starter-kit on GitHub's public AI-agents topic. Your project is described as “Give your AI agent personality, memory, and autonomy. Ready-to-use workspace template for OpenClaw.”. This is a speculative paid-pilot proposal, not a claim that you advertised a contract.

I prepared a five-minute, dependency-free demo that maps a small ai-agents workflow into three inspectable states: accepted input, refused input, and an exported receipt. For a Shell codebase, the proposed paid milestone would be deliberately narrow:

1. Identify one integration or verification seam maintainers currently test manually.
2. Implement a minimal adapter and a failing-path test without changing public APIs.
3. Deliver the patch, reproducible check, and short maintainer runbook.

Proof of delivery cadence: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ contains 21 live browser games, and https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 exposes the append-only receipts and operator-gated effect model used to keep agent work auditable. I am proposing integration labor, not asking you to adopt the surrounding mythology or infrastructure.

If that seam is real for your roadmap, the attached demo is the conversation starter; otherwise no follow-up is needed.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
